topic: What frequency planning challenges arise when coordinating multiple ground stations with overlapping satellite visibility windows?
consensus_response: Coordinating multiple ground stations with overlapping satellite visibility requires efficient spectrum management techniques. Dynamic frequency hopping (DFH) dynamically switches between frequencies to minimize interference, while Space-Time Adaptive Modulation (STAM) adjusts modulation parameters based on channel conditions for higher spectral efficiency.  These techniques require sophisticated resource allocation and scheduling algorithms to optimize performance in a decentralized network environment.
reference_context: Satellite communications face challenges with overlapping frequencies due to the increasing number of satellites deployed. This necessitates efficient spectrum sharing strategies such as DFH and STAM. These methods prioritize data transmission while minimizing interference, ensuring seamless service quality despite shared resources.
